A [[types]] entry, opt-in, not shipped enabled in the default config:

intent: Design first-class support in lazyspec for hydra interviews: the lazyspec CLI and TUI should read `.hydra/<slug>.json` decision trees as a document store, the way they already read filesystem markdown, github-issues, git-ref and clickup-tasks. The user asked explicitly for a VERY SIMPLE feature — the interview should resist scope creep toward bidirectional sync, hydra-driving-from-lazyspec, or a bespoke TUI mode unless the user chooses it. Output feeds a lazyspec RFC/story/iteration chain in this repo.
